title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
summary: Relativity Networks deals in hollow-core fiber, a rarely deployed technology that allows data to be transmitted 30% faster than conventional fiber. The second era optimized the networking inside the data center to take advantage of that compute.
